diffs.diff: voltage (V, VREF=5V): datasheet reading gives 0.001220703125 per count, the part's model has none
diffs.evidence: Datasheet DS21298E Section 4.0, Equation 4-1: 'Digital Output Code = 4096 x VIN / VREF' and 'the reference input (VREF) determines the analog input voltage range'. So volts per count = VREF/4096. The second reading assumed VREF = 5 V (5/4096 = 0.001220703125). The model wires VREF to 3.3 V for ESP32/Pico use, and its sim.spiReplies use 3.3/4096 = 0.0008056640625 V per count on all 8 channels; the driver computes raw * vref / 4096. Both follow the same equation; only the VREF assumption differs. The gate reports 'none' because it reads sim.responses, while this SPI model stores its scale in sim.spiReplies.
